open_questions: SDS DL2-13720.pdf p.3 component shares: ZDDP >=10 - <12,5 %; molybdenum polysulphide long chain alkyl dithiocarbamate complex >=0,25 - <1 % (not element contents). SDS p.12 'Pour point : not determined'.
